$comment: Committed, hashed facts about the SERVED Bell host, rendered by /bell and /bell/method through apps/site/lib/bell-served-load.ts after a sha256 check against apps/site/data/manifest.sha256.json (lot BELL-SERVED-1; decision 155). Written by scripts/sync-bell-served.mjs (source-repo tool) from two GETs: /timeline.jsonl and /bell/pubkey.json, after checking that the served key set equals the committed keyring and that the first line is a signed, genesis-chained publication at seq 1 under that keyring. first_record = that first line's seq, published_at, line_hash (sha256 of its canonical bytes) and key_id; bodies_sha256 = the sha256 of the two bodies as read at read_at (the timeline body grows with each publication; the first line does not change). No other field of the line is copied and no market value is read.
